name: Align Technology

logo.source: commons.wikimedia.org (Align Technology logo.svg); company site PNG tagline version also checked; no Wikipedia infobox logo

description: Align makes the Invisalign clear aligners and iTero intraoral scanners. Doctors (orthodontists and general dentists) pay per aligner case, so revenue follows case volume and average price; aligners are made to order from a 3D scan and treatment plan, and are 80 percent of sales. The scanner business (20 percent) sells iTero hardware plus recurring software and services to the same doctors, which also feeds aligner cases. Align estimates its share at about 10 percent of the 22 million orthodontic case starts a year, most of which are still wires and brackets.

employees.note: about 91 percent outside the US, mostly direct-labor roles in manufacturing and treatment planning

businessLines.how: Doctors (orthodontists and GPs) and dental support organisations pay per aligner case (Invisalign system and retainers); revenue is case volume times average selling price, with deferred revenue for unused refinements.
